name: Teen Achievers
what_you_do: A college and career program. It has goal setting, mentors and service projects. It also has tours of colleges and trade schools and visits to workplaces.
who_can_apply: Open to middle school students at Sulphur Springs K-8. Also open to high school students at Middleton High School. Also open to youth 12 to 18 at the Bob Gilbertson Central City YMCA.
duration: School year; summer at some sites
deadline_text: Enrollment begins in September for the school year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the teen sign up form and the program agreement. Email them to Meagan Smithyman at msmithyma@tampaymca.org.
notes: Cost is not stated on the page. Ask the Y.
